title: _scaled_mm_cuda fails on H100 with fp8
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Running 
```bash
python test/test_ops.py TestCommonCUDA.test_out_warning_torch__scaled_mm_cuda
```
on an H100 machine gives the following error:
```bash
======================================================================
ERROR: test_out_warning_torch__scaled_mm_cuda (__main__.TestCommonCUDA.test_out_warning_torch__scaled_mm_cuda)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 1151, in test_wrapper
    return test(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 1231, in dep_fn
    return fn(slf, *args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/test/test_ops.py", line 951, in test_out_warning
    expected = op(sample.input, *sample.args, **sample.kwargs)
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/opinfo/core.py", line 1186, in __call__
    return self.op(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
RuntimeError: CUDA error: CUBLAS_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE when calling cublasLtMatmul with transpose_mat1 t transpose_mat2 n m 32 n 15 k 16 mat1_ld 16 mat2_ld 16 result_ld 32 computeType 68 scaleType 0

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_utils.py", line 3334, in wrapper
    method(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_utils.py", line 3334, in wrapper
    method(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 428, in instantiated_test
    result = test(self, **param_kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 1231, in dep_fn
    return fn(slf, *args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 1231, in dep_fn
    return fn(slf, *args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_utils.py", line 1741, in wrapper
    fn(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/workspace/pytorch/torch/testing/_internal/common_device_type.py", line 1163, in test_wrapper
    raise e_tracked from e
Exception: CUDA error: CUBLAS_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE when calling cublasLtMatmul with transpose_mat1 t transpose_mat2 n m 32 n 15 k 16 mat1_ld 16 mat2_ld 16 result_ld 32 computeType 68 scaleType 0

Caused by sample input at index 0: SampleInput(input=Tensor[size=(15, 16), device="cuda:0", dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn], args=TensorList[Tensor[size=(16, 32), device="cuda:0", dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, contiguous=False], Tensor[size=(1,), device="cuda:0", dtype=torch.float32], Tensor[size=(1,), device="cuda:0", dtype=torch.float32]], kwargs={}, broadcasts_input=False, name='')

To execute this test, run the following from the base repo dir:
    PYTORCH_OPINFO_SAMPLE_INPUT_INDEX=0 python test/test_ops.py TestCommonCUDA.test_out_warning_torch__scaled_mm_cuda

This message can be suppressed by setting PYTORCH_PRINT_REPRO_ON_FAILURE=0

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ran 1 test in 2.313s

FAILED (errors=1)
```

Replacing `result_ptr` with `nullptr` as in #167873 seems to resolve this, at least when `beta` is on host. See version info below.
